solution:
Combine the logarithms:
$$\log_{2}\bigl(x(x-2)\bigr)=3\quad\Rightarrow\quad x(x-2)=2^{3}=8.$$
So $x^{2}-2x-8=0$, i.e. $(x-4)(x+2)=0$. The root $x=-2$ is invalid because we need $x>2$ (so that both logs are defined). Hence $x=4$.
Check: $\log_{2}4+\log_{2}2=2+1=3$.
